why:
phase-427 W9 (2026-09-07) — LANDED. `Context::baked() -> Result<Context, InitError>` (`packages/api/nros/src/init.rs:329`): the FREESTANDING constructor, from the constants baked into this crate at compile time — `option_env!("NROS_LOCATOR")` (unset or empty ⇒ empty ⇒ the linked backend's own default, issue 0330) and `option_env!("NROS_DOMAIN_ID")` (unset ⇒ 0; non-numeric ⇒ `EnvParseFailed`; above `DOMAIN_ID_MAX` ⇒ `DomainIdOutOfRange`). Mode `Client`, `rmw` empty, source `ContextSource::Baked`. This is what `default_from_env()` / `from_env()` resolve to when `env` is off, and it is the ONE `option_env!` site for the pair: the entry macros (`nros::zephyr_component_main!`, `packages/api/nros/src/lib.rs:953`; `nros::main!`'s Zephyr arm, `packages/core/nros-macros/src/main_macro.rs:1960`) used to carry their own copies and assemble an `ExecutorConfig` by hand — and the `main!` copy had lost the domain half (issue 0161's class), so a workspace Zephyr entry ran domain 0 whatever Kconfig said. Both call `Context::default_from_env()` now. The values reach THIS crate's build through `nros_zephyr_build::bake_nros_config()` in `packages/api/nros/build.rs:37` (Kconfig via `$DOTCONFIG`, the issue-0460 channel) or the process environment of a fixture build. The parse behind it, `Context::from_baked(locator, domain)` (`:338`, `#[doc(hidden)]`), takes the two constants as arguments so a unit test covers every arm without a build environment (`init::baked_tests`). `with_locator_override` (`:364`) is the harness's `-testargs --nros-locator=<loc>` override on top (#166 / phase-286 W1), resolved in the entry because the `nros_runtime_locator_override` hook is an `extern "C"` only a Zephyr image defines.

No upstream counterpart: rclrs has one constructor family and a process environment on every target it supports; this is the RTOS half of `rust:Context::default_from_env`'s bounded adoption, and the reason that row can say `adopt`.
